11:
4 Wrestlers fight at the same time to be the
last man standing.
You can choose the number of entrants in the 
match, with the maximum number being 40.
Every time a Wrestler is eliminated, the next
entrant makes their way to the ring.

With 4 controllers, 4 people can play.

@Y(PPV Mode Note)@D
　　In PPV Mode, settings are fixed at
　　@R40 entrants @Dwith a @GRandom @Dentry.

　　$1......Delete character

　　$9......Insert space

　　$2$3...Move cursor in input area

21:
A mode for competing in singles
rankings. 3 to 16 wrestlers can
take part.
22:
A mode for competing in tag team
rankings. 3 to 16 teams can
take part.
23:
@G[Choosing opponents]@D
　　Choose who fights from the rankings
　　with $a$b and press $0, then choose
　　the opponent the same way from the
　　area that is not dimmed.

@G[About challenge limits]@D
　　In Ranking Mode, a low-ranked
　　wrestler cannot challenge the
　　champion right away. The dimmed area
　　limits who can be chosen.
　　For a low-ranked wrestler to fight
　　a high-ranked one, the lower-ranked
　　wrestler must climb the ranks first.
24:
Sets the sound output type, match
BGM selection, and match BGM volume.
25:
Freely change the controller button
assignments used during matches.

@G[How to change button assignments]@D
　　Select the item to change with $a$b
　　and press the button you want.
　　Note: $e, $4, $5, $f cannot be
　　assigned.

　　To restore the original assignments,
　　select @YRestore Defaults@D.
26:
Data settings and reference: saving
and loading data to the @BController
Pak@D, viewing wrestler records, etc.
27:
Matches in this mode always follow
these rules. You can view them but
not change them.
28:
Matches in this mode always follow
these rules.
29:
End this mode and return to the
main menu.

@Y(Royal Road Succession Note)@D
　　If you quit @RRoyal Road Succession@D
　　mode, that day's progress is not
　　saved. If you are in the middle of
　　a day, finish all that day's matches
　　before quitting.
30:
Save belt data to the @BController
Pak@D, or load it from the Pak.

Up to @R8@D belt data can be saved
to a @BController Pak@D.

@Y(Note)@D
　　This cannot be selected without a
　　@BController Pak@D. Also, always insert
　　the @BController Pak@D into the @R1P
　　Controller@D.
31:
Save wrestlers made in Edit Mode
to the @BController Pak@D, or load
them from the Pak.

Up to @R16@D created wrestlers can be
saved to a @BController Pak@D.

@Y(Note)@D
　　This cannot be selected without a
　　@BController Pak@D. Also, always insert
　　the @BController Pak@D into the @R1P
　　Controller@D.
32:
View the career records of wrestlers
on the cartridge: total matches,
wins, win rate, etc.
33:
View past Exhibition match results
as records.

Up to @R25 matches@D can be saved; past
that, old records are overwritten in
order.

Only @GExhibition@D @YSingles, Tag,
3Way@D matches are recorded.
34:
View belt data.

Each belt records its past holders,
the dates they won it, and the
number of defenses. Up to @R6@D past
holders are recorded; past that, the
oldest holder is overwritten first,
except the first champion, whose
record is never erased.
35:
Move belt data from the cartridge
to the @BController Pak@D, or from
the @BController Pak@D to the cart.

Select the belt to move with $f
and press $0, then select where
to move it the same way.

@Y(Note)@D
　　It is not final until you select
　　@RConfirm@D at the bottom of the screen.
　　Belts used in a league, tournament,
　　or event cannot be moved until that
　　event is finished.
36:
Delete belt data.

Select the belt to delete with $f
and press $0 to delete it.

@Y(Note)@D
　　It is @Rnot final@D until you select
　　@BConfirm@D at the bottom of the screen.
　　Belts in use in a league, tournament,
　　or event cannot be deleted. To delete
　　one, first delete the data of the
　　mode using the belt.
37:
View the data of wrestlers made
in Edit Mode.

You can view each wrestler's @Bprofile,
appearance, moves, parameters, logic@D.
Viewing only: nothing can be changed
here.

@Y(Note)@D
　　To use a wrestler saved on a
　　@BController Pak@D in a match, first
　　move him to the cartridge.
39:
Copy a wrestler's data to another
slot when you want an identical
wrestler in another slot.
@G(How to)@D
　　Select the wrestler to copy with $f
　　and press $0. Then select where to
　　copy to the same way and press $0
　　to copy.
@Y(Note)@D
　　Copying overwrites, so if you don't
　　want to erase the target wrestler,
　　move or copy him elsewhere first.
　　Also, it is @Rnot final@D until you
　　select @BConfirm@D at the very bottom
　　of the screen.
40:
A battle royal played in 4 teams.
Team sizes can be set freely, so
handicap matches are possible.

A team loses when all its members
are eliminated. Win by eliminating
every other team.
41:
A mode where a random wrestler
appears each time one is eliminated,
until one survives.

With no team setup or wrestler
selection, it is the quickest way
to enjoy a battle royal.
42:
Register the mic appeal text used
before and after matches.

Each set is 2 pages: the left side
is page 1, the right side is page 2.
Up to 8 different mic appeals can
be registered.

@Y(Note)@D
In Edit Mode's @GProfile@D, register
with the $6$7$8$9 buttons to show
any text on screen.
